$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file is checked against. Read by editors, ignored by Essence.

exclude.description: Directories under this project that are not its sources: a corpus kept broken on purpose, a vendored copy. Paths relative to this file, not globs. A file named on the command line or open in the editor is still compiled; this narrows the walk.

skipTags.description: Tags an everyday `essence test` leaves out. `--tag` brings one back for a run.

contracts.description: Whether every run also tests what the declarations promise, as `--contracts` does for one run. `--no-contracts` turns it off for a run.

cases.description: How many values each property test draws. `--cases` overrides it for a run.

coverage.description: How and where a coverage report is written when a run asks for one.

report.description: The report a `--coverage` run writes, as `--coverage-report` names it.

out.description: Where a coverage report is written, relative to this file, as `--coverage-out` names it.

build.description: How this project's bundles are made: the flags `build`, `run` and `watch` take, said once.

out.description: Where bundles are written, relative to this file, as `--out` names it.

sourcemap.description: Whether a source map is written beside every bundle, as `--sourcemap` asks for one run.

minify.description: Whether bundles are minified, as `--minify` asks for one run.

embed.description: Whether every bundle is built for embedding, with its descriptor beside it, as `--embed` asks for one run.

optimise.description: Whether the Optimiser runs. `false` is what `--no-optimise` says for one run.

withoutOptimisations.description: Optimiser passes left out, by name, as `--without-optimisation` names them one at a time.
